verdict.rationale: Vanta's marketing docs mention cross-mapping controls across frameworks 'you've customized' and bringing an existing program to Vanta across frameworks, and the developer docs describe pushing custom resources and turning them into pass/fail evidence via a 'Custom Test' — directly supporting custom tests/evidence requirements. However, there's no detailed documentation of a dedicated custom-framework/control builder UI, no walkthrough of authoring custom controls, and no independent corroboration of the feature working end-to-end. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on defining custom controls (not just frameworks), a full walkthrough of the custom framework builder, and independent/hands-on validation of the workflow.
